executive_summary: In highlight coverage, our prediction market analysis dominated earned media this week — our $20B World Cup blockchain volume report appeared across TradingView, BeInCrypto, incrypted, and CryptoRank, establishing us as the authoritative source on prediction market scale; simultaneously, our Coldcard wallet exploit analysis ($30M stolen in minutes targeting high-value addresses) ran across CryptoRank and Bitcoin World, and our stablecoin infrastructure forecast ($1.5 quadrillion annual processing by 2035) secured CoinMarketCap placement. In crypto news, the Coldcard security breach dominated narrative coverage, with CoinDesk reporting the $38M exploit is driving institutional migration from self-custody to ETFs and raising questions about wallet diversification; Solana Foundation's new CISO flagged AI-driven scam sophistication outpacing defenses; and Tether reported $1.5B Q2 operating profit despite reserve buffer declining by half. In competitor news, Elliptic secured placements on Sei and HashKey compliance scaling wins; Arkham Intelligence pivoted to full decentralization on CoinMarketCap; TRM Labs' Ari Redbord appeared in CoinDesk discussing AI-targeted scams; and Merkle Science positioned blockchain privacy for regulatory alignment in Crypto Briefing.

market_landscape.title: Institutional Adoption Via Custody Migration
market_landscape.body: Self-custody security failures are driving capital toward regulated custodians and spot ETFs, narrowing the addressable market for peer-to-peer on-chain activity. We must deepen integration with custodial platforms and ETF issuers to maintain transaction volume visibility and regulatory reporting leverage.

market_landscape.title: Compliance Infrastructure Consolidation
market_landscape.body: Post-MiCA and post-sanctions enforcement, enterprise clients are consolidating compliance vendors around integrated AML/CFT, transaction monitoring, and sanctions screening. Our Polymarket partnership and stablecoin monitoring scale position us well, but we face increased pricing pressure from Elliptic and emerging VASP-focused competitors.

market_landscape.title: AI-Augmented Illicit Finance & Fraud Acceleration
market_landscape.body: AI-driven scam sophistication and institutional-scale sanctions evasion networks are outpacing rule-based detection; machine learning model refresh cycles are now critical to regulatory value delivery. Real-time behavioral risk scoring and cross-chain settlement anomaly detection are becoming regulatory expectations rather than differentiators.
